_comment: Maps each Sounds.json event key to one file inside the Kenney zips in assets/.
Picks were made by FILENAME ONLY - nobody has listened to these yet. Audition them
with `py tools/upload_audio.py --audition` and swap any `pick` you dislike for one of
its `alternates` before uploading. Open Cloud audio uploads are capped per month
(10 unverified / 100 ID-verified), so a bad pick costs a slot that cannot be reclaimed.
`ambient` entries in Sounds.json stay 0: these four packs contain no loopable music beds.
Combat keys (swing..mentor) were picked by filename and ogg duration only. The packs have no
whoosh, bow, gun, laser or voice sounds, so those keys use the nearest stand-in (see `wants`).

Village.source: OpenGameArt, RandomMind, 'Medieval: The Bard's Tale' loop version

uiClick.wants: short, dry, quiet tick - fires on every button press, so it must never grate

purchase.wants: single crisp chip/coin placement - the reward beat of the core loop

reveal.wants: soft thud as a building lands (spec 9); pairs under the purchase sound

levelUp.wants: short rising tick; pitch-shifted up per milestone, so it must survive +0.08 steps

levelUpMilestone.wants: brief bright flourish at levels 10/25/50/100 - stacks on top of levelUp

insufficientFunds.wants: soft negative blip, not harsh - players hit this constantly while saving up

eraAdvance.wants: triumphant fanfare under the era ceremony overlay - the game's biggest moment

rebirth.wants: grander than eraAdvance - rarer and more final; must read as a bigger deal

welcomeBack.wants: short friendly greeting on the welcome-back card - non-blocking, low volume

swing.wants: quick airy swish for each melee combo hit (0.46 s); no whoosh pack, a card slide is the closest swipe

finisher.wants: heavy meaty thump on the third-hit 1.6x cleave - clearly weightier than enemyHit

bowDraw.wants: short quiet creak/stretch as the bow is drawn; no bow pack, a scratch is the nearest string-tension sound

bowFire.wants: dry string twang/thwip on release (0.16 s) - fires often, keep it light

gunFire.wants: punchy short crack for Boomtown/Metropolis ranged shots; no gun pack, a tight metal impact stands in

laser.wants: short falling synthetic 'pew' for Orbital ranged weapons; no laser pack, a UI sweep is the closest

abilityCast.wants: rising charged whoosh/chime when a weapon ability fires (AoE or burst) - distinct from every hit

enemyHit.wants: light confirming smack on every hit that lands; plays constantly, so short and quiet

enemyDeath.wants: soft body-drop thud when an enemy falls - satisfying but not louder than finisher

playerHit.wants: dull hurt thump when the local player takes damage - must read as 'you got hit', not 'you hit'

playerDown.wants: single low bell toll when the player is downed - heavy, final, under 1 s

waveStart.wants: short punchy sting announcing a new wave (~0.5 s)

waveClear.wants: bright light resolve when a wave is cleared - a breather cue

bossStart.wants: longer ominous hit-sting as the boss spawns - the loudest combat cue

bossDown.wants: triumphant flourish when the boss dies - bigger than waveClear

runEnd.wants: closing jingle under the run summary card - neutral enough for win or wipe

lowHp.wants: soft muffled heartbeat thump repeated while HP is low - very quiet, must not nag

partyRally.wants: upbeat call-to-arms sting when a teammate rallies the party

partyWarcry.wants: brassy horn blast for the party warcry; no voice pack, a sax stab is the nearest horn

mentor.wants: warm soft chime when the Mentor bonus is awarded for carrying a newer player
